Chapter 241: The End Of The Road

The Zerg army is passing through the center of the battlefield, chasing the alien breakout troops in the east. Wu Qing wants to catch the big fish.

The blocking battles of the local camp army are not going well now, mainly because the alien army is too powerful. The army of the super tribe is indeed not comparable to the army of ordinary races that are not even ordinary strong tribes.

The total strength of the Zerg army is only more than 500,000, and the strength of each branch is not large. They cannot be separated and fight alone, otherwise they will be easily counterattacked by the alien army.

The firepower of the Zerg destroyers is still chasing the alien breakout troops in the east, which have been very scattered and many of them have been mixed into the local camp army. It is temporarily unable to support the other two directions.

Wu Qing looked at the Zerg flying dragon group in the sky and the eighty five-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes mixed in it, and finally sent thirty five-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes to the south and north respectively.

Even the five-star Zerg Exploding Swarm is not big in size. Their powerful power comes from the extremely compressed energy in their bodies and the full vitality that burns instantly.

Those who pay attention to the movements of the Zerg Exploding Swarm from time to time only see a series of shadows flashing by quickly.

For the attack on ordinary troops, the five-star Zerg Exploding Swarm directly turns on the acceleration mode and arrives above the target in an instant.

With the real-time intelligence provided by the Zerg host and the control and command of the queen, the Zerg combat units have always attacked quickly, accurately and efficiently!

"Boom boom boom... boom...!"

Sixty loud noises sounded from different locations, shaking the entire battlefield!

As five-star strength, the Zerg Exploding Swarm gathers the whole body's energy and life essence compared to the Zerg Destroyer and Zerg Dragon, blooming in an instant and bursting out the strongest attack in an instant!

This attack method is completely incomparable to the attack of ordinary five-star soldiers!

A total of sixty five-star Zerg Exploding Swarms rushed evenly into the troops of the alien army breaking out from the south and north!

The strength of the two breakout troops of the alien race was instantly reduced by half, and the remaining troops, except for a few melee troops close to the local camp army, were severely damaged!

The Zerg Exploding Swarm's shocking explosion completely made the troops of the alien army breaking out from the south and north completely lose the chance of a successful breakout, and now even self-protection has become a problem.

"The Zerg's self-destructing flying troop can be called a strategic troop!"

"Keep bombing like this! No matter how many enemies there are, they won't be enough to kill!"

"The breakout troops of the two powerful alien armies are finished just like that!"

"Fortunately, there are not many troop types like the Zerg, otherwise why would we fight? We can just bomb them all the way!"

"Don't worry too much. Even the strongest troop types have weaknesses. It's just that the Zerg has just appeared and everyone is not familiar with them. It will be fine after getting used to them!"

"..."

Even the various forces in the local camp are a little afraid of Zerg troop types like the Zerg Exploding Swarm.

The Zerg flying dragon group above the Zerg army split into two groups, one in the south and one in the north, following the Zerg Exploding Swarm and rushing over.

Before the huge explosion stopped, they launched a fierce attack on the surviving breakout troops of the alien army below, bearing the energy impact of the explosion.

The Zerg paid the price of sixty five-star Zerg self-destruct mosquitoes. The advantage cannot be taken by the armies of other local camps. The Zerg dragon group is to grab heads.

The Zerg dragon group, which already has a thousand five-star Zerg dragons, is not as efficient in killing enemies as before. They harvested all the way from the air. The soldiers of the breakout troops of the alien army, who had already suffered heavy damage, could no longer withstand such attacks and all disappeared in light.

The army of the local camp that was carrying out the blocking operation instantly became very motivated. They directly gave up the defensive operation and launched a counterattack against the remaining breakout troops of the alien army regardless of everything!

Wu Qing did not eat alone. When the Zerg dragon group attacked the area near the front line of the local camp army, it stopped and returned to the Zerg army.

The remaining enemies and the entire battlefield were left to the army of the local camp.

The Zerg army continued to move eastward. The attack of the Zerg destroyer first drove the breakout troops of the alien army into the army of the local camp.

Then they bombarded the light-attribute energy shield with extremely strong defensive capabilities, but they failed to break the shield in the end, allowing them to rush into the local camp army.

The alien human army that broke out to the east was much stronger than the other two breakout troops, and there were a large number of strong human mages and human priests.

The alien human breakout troops that rushed into the defense position of the local camp army were divided into powerful teams, and continued to attack eastward in the local camp army.

The human mages and human priests cooperated with each other and played a huge role at this time. Various powerful attack magics attacked the blocking local camp army, opening up one gap after another, allowing the melee soldiers in front to rush in.

From the high-altitude perspective of the Zerg host, it was like many fierce fish breaking through the waves in a body of water. The local camp army, which was as numerous as water, could not stop the alien army that attacked like fierce fish.

The huge light attribute energy shield entered the local camp army. As long as it came into contact with the soldiers of the local camp army, it would produce huge purification and annihilation damage. The soldiers who rushed up to attack were all purified into nothingness!

With the protection of such a terrible light attribute energy shield, no one could stop it!

The Zerg army rushed to the vicinity, and all the surroundings became besieged by the local camp army soldiers, making it impossible for the Zerg army to move forward.

"Let them go! We are going to attack indiscriminately!"

Wu Qing asked the Zerg host in the air to shout that the local camp army should let the alien army go. If they continued to block it like this, it would only increase casualties.

Shortly after the Zerg host finished speaking, "Boom...!" Several explosions sounded, and several five-star Zerg destroyers fired several rounds at the alien breakout troops sandwiched between the local camp army.

The terrible attack of the five-star Zerg destroyers cleared a large area of the alien army and also accidentally injured many soldiers of the local camp army.

The soldiers of the local camp army finally felt the power of the Zerg destroyers' attacks at close range.

"They are warning us! Should we retreat or not!?"

"Order to retreat! We can't stop it, so we won't fight!"

"..."

The local camp army responsible for blocking in the east realized that it could not stop the alien army's breakout with just a large number of troops, so it no longer entangled with the alien army, and took the initiative to retreat and distance itself.

The local camp army began to retreat in an all-round way, giving up the passage to the east and handing the battle to the Zerg army.

Seeing the breakout passage open, the alien army continued to maintain the existing dispersed team formation and quickly broke out to the east.

"Boom boom boom...!"

The Zerg destroyers, with the intelligence of the Zerg host and the precise calculation of the queen, distributed their firepower and launched attacks on the various teams of the alien human army that broke through.

Such an efficient command system made every scattered team of the alien human army suffer attacks and unable to break through at a normal speed.

Many of the teams attacked by high-star Zerg destroyers were directly wiped out!

Each team left behind a large number of wounded and could not continue to take them away!

This made the retreating local camp army scalp numb. If such an attack fell on them, none of them would survive.

In the light attribute energy shield, the mysterious human knight looked at the situation outside and said: "It is a luxury to want to bring back the army. I will try my best to bring you back!"

After he said this, he galloped on his horse and rushed eastward quickly.

The powerful human priests around him controlled the light attribute energy shield and followed the footsteps of the mysterious human knight.

All the people who were originally in the light energy shield galloped on horseback and followed closely.

The core command of the alien human army has seen the situation clearly and decided to abandon the remnants of the alien human army.

Facing the current battle situation, it is no longer necessary for them to try to save it.

"Come pick me up!"

Wu Qing said to the Queen.

A transport host flew over Wu Qing, and Wu Qing and ten Zerg guards rode into the loading space of the transport host.

The transport host picked up Wu Qing and flew to the Zerg flying dragon group in the sky.

One hundred five-star Zerg queens, the remaining twenty five-star Zerg explosive mosquitoes, and most of the four-star Zerg hosts were mixed in the Zerg flying dragon group.

The transport host that Wu Qing was riding flew into the Zerg flying dragon group, and the huge Zerg flying dragon group immediately chased the mysterious human knight and his group who were moving away quickly.

The remaining alien breakout troops stopped breaking out when the mysterious human knight led his men to run away, but turned around and launched a final charge in the direction of the Zerg army!

Under the precise calculation of the Queen of Zerg, two thousand five-star Zerg destroyers led the way, and each round of attack could destroy tens of thousands of alien troops.

The last strong army of the alien army charged halfway, and under several rounds of attacks by the Zerg destroyers, there were wounded soldiers left on the ground.

At this point, the main battle of this war was basically over. The Zerg destroyers didn't care whether it was a waste or not, and they kept attacking the wounded soldiers of the alien army on the ground.

The Zerg army steadily advanced forward and killed the wounded soldiers of the alien army who survived the attack of the Zerg destroyers. These ordinary alien soldiers were of no value to Wu Qing, and they could not be rescued, so they could only be eliminated.

Wu Qing and ten Zerg guards entered the loading space of the transport host, and then they evolved into pupae and upgraded their strength to five stars.
